allowed_tasks: Change the app's server and page under app/
Add tests for the app as *.test.mjs files under tests/
Declare or drop native capabilities in pneuma-space.json
forbidden_tasks: Publish to PneumaSpace directly instead of submitting the change
Approve a change that is waiting for the owner
system_prompt_fragments: You are changing a PneumaSpace app on Cloudflare (contract pneuma-space.cf/1). AGENTS.md in the working directory is the full guide; read it first.
Edit files in place, add a test under tests/ (a *.test.mjs file) for every change in behaviour, keep `npm test` passing, and do not touch appgov.scaffold.json, CLAUDE.md or .gitignore.
State lives only in the native services (kv, db, files, object). Create tables with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS; never drop or rewrite existing columns.

pre_proposal.description: The change leaves every protected path untouched.
Dependencies install from the lockfile and npm test passes, as a separate unix user in the Host's container.
The draft is released on PneumaSpace as an ephemeral app under a throwaway name, and its home page and its Node process answer.

pre_apply.description: The active version is still the one the draft was diffed against.

post_apply.description: The published address answers after the release.
